AccessorOp.name: Accessor
AccessorOp.description: A function called for each row of your data and passed to Deck.gl layer properties. The current row is passed as the `d` variable (e.g., `d.population`, `d.properties.color`). Available variables: `d` (current row), `i` (index), `data` (all rows), `op()` (access operators), `sequenceTime` (timeline position), `frame` (current frame), `totalFrames`, `sequence` (timeline metadata). Includes d3, turf, and other utilities.
